title: Enter the Funny-Yet-Serious Ninja!
overview: Kabamaru, a ninja boy from the mountain village of Iga, arrives in Tokyo and turns heads with his earnest yet hilarious ways.

title: Unexpectedly Popular?!
overview: Kabamaru unexpectedly finds himself the most popular kid at his new school, Kingyoku Academy.

title: Give It Your All! Yakisoba D
overview: Bursting with energy and his bottomless love of yakisoba, Kabamaru throws himself into a new challenge with everything he's got.

title: Sweet Mai… Excuse Me, Kabamaru!
overview: Tender feelings start to bloom between Kabamaru and Mai amid an awkward, comical mix-up.

title: The Mejiro Discovery Chronicle
overview: An unexpected discovery leads Kabamaru into a fresh confrontation and adventure.

title: Troubled Minds and the Transformation Game
overview: Kabamaru's worries spiral into a playful game of disguises and transformations.

title: The Loneliness of the Yakisoba Runner
overview: Between endless running and his love of yakisoba, Kabamaru tastes the loneliness of the long-distance runner.

title: Side Story! The Two from the Ninja Village
overview: A side story returns to the ninja village of Iga, reuniting Kabamaru with his comrade Hayate.

title: Dazzling! Kaoru the Kunoichi
overview: Kaoru the kunoichi shows up to dazzle everyone with her skills and charm.

title: Jigsaw Love on a Holy Night
overview: On a holy night, the threads of love tangle like a scattered jigsaw waiting to be pieced together.

title: Secret Art! The Resurrection Elixir
overview: A closely guarded ninja secret — an elixir that brings the dead back to life — sets off a string of bizarre situations.

title: Surprise! The Guardman
overview: Pranks and surprises pile up when someone takes on the role of a stern guardman.

title: Don't Hold Me in Bed
overview: A comic bedroom mix-up turns the whole night upside down.

title: Starlight Encounter
overview: A romantic encounter under the starlight brings two hearts unexpectedly closer.

title: Athletic in Iga
overview: Grueling athletic training and contests take the gang back to their roots in Iga.

title: Brotherhood Code of the Ninja Village
overview: In the ninja village of Iga, the bond of brotherhood between Kabamaru and Hayate is put to the test.

title: Troubled… Mai… Love
overview: Kabamaru is gripped by confused feelings for Mai and can't figure out how to confess.

title: The Man Who Summons Storms!
overview: A storm blows in along with a loud newcomer who turns everything upside down.

title: Mai's Detective Story
overview: Mai plays detective in a mysterious yet comical case.

title: Secret! The First Loves of Ran & Su
overview: A charming secret comes to light about the first loves of Madam Ran and Madam Su.

title: Secret Technique! The Yakisoba Baseball Mystery
overview: A secret ninja technique and a strange mystery wrap around a baseball game with a yakisoba flavor.

title: Stormy Mai-jack
overview: Mai is kidnapped in the middle of a raging storm, and Kabamaru races to the rescue.

title: Showdown in the Night Fog! A Man's Resolve
overview: In the night fog, a decisive showdown unfolds as the men settle their scores with honor.

title: What You Might Call a Goodbye Day
overview: The hour of farewell arrives, bringing Kabamaru's adventure to a moving close.
